Company Update

TurboFlow Raises $6 Million Seed Round Led by Pantera Capital

TurboFlow announced a $6 million seed round led by Pantera Capital, with participation from Susquehanna Crypto and Digital Currency Group. The company said the capital will support product development, liquidity infrastructure, and global user growth.

Published June 22, 2026 Updated August 12, 2026 By TurboFlow

Source: TurboFlow: $6 Million Seed Round Announcement (PR Newswire)

Key facts

Funding
$6 million
Round
Seed
Lead investor
Pantera Capital
Participants
Susquehanna Crypto and Digital Currency Group
Announced
June 22, 2026, 8:05 p.m. ET

On June 22, 2026, TurboFlow announced the closing of a $6 million seed funding round led by Pantera Capital, with participation from Susquehanna Crypto and Digital Currency Group.

TurboFlow said it will use the capital to expand product development, strengthen liquidity infrastructure, and accelerate global user growth.

What TurboFlow said it is building

In the announcement, TurboFlow described itself as an on-chain trading ecosystem at the intersection of perpetual contracts and prediction markets. Its stated aim is to make professional-grade market infrastructure available to everyday users through a simpler, consumer-focused experience.

The release highlighted entry thresholds as low as $2, fast settlement for short-duration Event Contracts, and a streamlined experience intended to reduce blockchain complexity while preserving transparency and self-custody principles.

Activity reported in the announcement

At the time of the announcement, TurboFlow reported $19.15 billion in total trading volume across more than 14,540 total users. These are company-reported figures dated June 22, 2026; they are not presented here as independently audited or current metrics.

Pantera's statement

In the release, Pantera Managing Partner Paul Veradittakit said TurboFlow's goal of broadening access to institutional-grade trading infrastructure aligned with Pantera's view that blockchain can support more transparent and inclusive markets. He cited the company's early traction and product vision as part of Pantera's investment view.
